verdict.rationale: Companies House runs an online filing flow (file accounts, change registered office, file documents instead of posting paper forms), so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows it publishes operating-hours windows, per-day filing limits, or session timeouts before a founder starts. The only limit-related item is a 'Rate limiting' guide for the developer REST API, which covers programmatic access, not the founder-facing online filing flow.
